parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin metal or plastic frame. It is flat and rectangular, forming the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual content such as images, videos, or text. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed to the supporting structure and does not move independently, though the entire display may tilt or adjust in height depending on the stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base part of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It includes the stand and bottom platform that holds the screen upright.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, ensuring it remains stable on a flat surface. It may also allow for height or tilt adjustments.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may include a hinge or telescoping mechanism to adjust the screen’s position.
